name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Ranger and Longsword, one goes with Sable and the other with Viper.
Toad goes with Sable if and only if Greataxe goes with Orin.
Bard, Longsword, and Toad belong to different adventurers.
Wrenna goes with at least two of Bard, Necromancy, and Viper.
Rapier goes with exactly two of Orin, Ranger, Illusion, and Owl.
